events.description: Multiple individuals in yellow vests and dark uniforms engage in close physical combat, including punching, grappling, and shoving; one person in a yellow vest is struck repeatedly while others intervene.

Sustained chaotic group confrontation involving multiple uniformed officers and individuals in yellow vests amid heavy smoke or tear gas; includes coordinated pushing, use of batons/shields, and dispersal attempts, indicating collective violent unrest.

A person in a yellow vest appears restrained or overwhelmed by multiple officers and is struck while in a vulnerable posture (head down, arms not actively defending), suggesting targeted assault on a helpless individual.

A chaotic street scene with heavy smoke or tear gas, multiple individuals in yellow vests (some appearing to be protesters), and uniformed officers (some in helmets and dark gear) moving through the haze; there is apparent confrontation and movement consistent with violent unrest or clashing groups.

In frames f8–f10, a person in a yellow vest appears to be struck or pushed by an officer in dark uniform and helmet; the yellow-vested individual recoils and raises hands, suggesting a non-consensual physical attack on a seemingly non-aggressive individual.

Two silhouetted individuals on a rooftop or elevated platform are holding and aiming long firearms (appearing to be rifles) toward the street below; their postures remain consistent across frames, indicating sustained aiming/engagement.

Two silhouetted individuals on an elevated platform are holding long firearms in aiming positions over a street at night; the right individual repeatedly adjusts aim and appears to fire (muzzle flash not visible due to low resolution and backlighting, but sustained aiming posture and slight recoil-like motion across frames f0–f15 support active engagement).

A large crowd of people wearing yellow vests is gathered in a street, with multiple streams of water being sprayed from the front (likely from police water cannons) and significant white smoke or mist rising in the background, indicating active confrontation and dispersal efforts. The crowd remains dense and reactive throughout the sequence, with some individuals raising arms or turning toward the source of the spray.

Large crowd of people wearing yellow vests gathered in an urban street with thick smoke rising in the background, indicating ongoing unrest or confrontation; individuals are observing, some raising arms, and a French flag is visible amid the smoke—consistent with a violent protest or riot scenario.

At approximately 104.0 seconds (frame f8), a small object is visibly airborne mid-frame, appearing to be propelled upward sharply against the smoke background—suggestive of a projectile launch or small explosion (e.g., tear gas canister or flare being deployed). No fireball or shockwave is visible, but the sudden trajectory change and context support a minor explosive deployment.
